Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Here are two questions about Baldersar Rossellini's special:

a/ Suppose I control Baldesar Rossellini and a Lasombra with 1 blood.
Can the Lasombra equip with the Zaire River Ferry with Baldesar
announcing he'll reduce that card's cost at resolution (*)?
My supposition is he can, just the same way a Ravnos Embrace can play
an Embrace if there is a Ravnos Carnival with 2 counters on it.

(*) : Baldesar's ability is used when the cost is paid :
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/06e6c9c4a18d1db8

b/ Suppose my prey / predator / grand-prey / grand-predator controls
Baldesar Rossellini, and my Lasombra with 1 blood wants to equip with
a Zaire River Ferry.
Can he attempt that action?
I think he couldn't. I feel like the acting Methuselah can't give
other Methuselahs the impulse to do stuff as she sets the terms of the
action. So noone else would get the opportunity to announce their will
of reducing the cost with Baldesar's ability.

Thanks,
Pascal.

~~

Baldesar Rossellini
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Giovanni
Group: 4
Capacity: 8
Discipline: aus for nec DOM POT
Independent: Once each turn, if Baldesar is ready, he can reduce the
cost of a location or of an equipment by 1 pool or blood. +1 strength.

Zaire River Ferry
Cardtype: Equipment
Clan: Lasombra
Cost: 2 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play. Haven.
You may tap this location when a (D) action directed at this Lasombra
is announced to cause that action to fail. The Lasombra with this
location may tap it to get +1 stealth for the current action. A
vampire may have only one haven.

> announcing he'll reduce that card's cost at resolution (*)?
> My supposition is he can, just the same way a Ravnos Embrace can play

Correct, as cited.

> (*) : Baldesar's ability is used when the cost is paid :http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/06e6...

>
> b/ Suppose my prey / predator / grand-prey / grand-predator controls
> Baldesar Rossellini, and my Lasombra with 1 blood wants to equip with
> a Zaire River Ferry.
> Can he attempt that action?
> I think he couldn't. I feel like the acting Methuselah can't give
> other Methuselahs the impulse to do stuff as she sets the terms of the
> action. So noone else would get the opportunity to announce their will
> of reducing the cost with Baldesar's ability.

No. Baldesar's ability only works on your costs. He can't spread it
around.
He printed text includes "you play". When applying the 7/7/7 ruling to
his text (the reduction applies to all things that make you pay the
cost, not just playing as normal), I introduced excess utility. It
should say "you pay". (edited below)

Baldesar Rossellini
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Giovanni
Group: 4
Capacity: 8
Discipline: aus for nec DOM POT
Independent: Once each turn, if Baldesar is ready, he can reduce the

cost of a location or of an equipment YOU PAY by 1 pool or blood. +1
